messages:
Oncall Bot: ALERT — streaming-proxy p95/p99 latency breach detected for /v1/stream (region: us-west-2). Paging on-call. metric_snapshot: p95=0.92s p99=2.37s error_rate=0.3% :rotating_light:
Alex: I'm on it. seeing a pile of long-lived SSE connections sitting in CLOSE_WAIT on the proxy.
Marta: can you paste a quick topo? which proxy (envoy/nginx/haproxy) is fronting streaming today?
Alex: env-front-3 (envoy). I see Envoy upstream pending queue growing, and chunk flush intervals look delayed. suspect buffering in the proxy when clients stop consuming quickly.
Josh: customer reports intermittent stalls during long responses (tokens trickle then freeze). Could be client backpressure + proxy write buffer full.
Kevin: grabbing envoy stats now.
Kevin: envoy cluster info: upstream_rq_pending_overflow: 0 upstream_rq_503: 0 cluster_vhost_streaming_active: 142
Kevin: socket_write_total_bytes seems flat while upstream_sent_bytes rising — suggests downstream stalls.
Alex: logs show repeated EPIPE and write failures on proxy side, followed by connection resets to clients. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T01:12:03Z ERROR envoy connection write failed: errno=32 Broken pipe peer=10.2.3.45:54822
2026-03-15T01:12:03Z WARN stream id=0x7f4 flush delayed ms=6200
```
Marta: could slow consumers (mobile clients with flaky networks) be causing head-of-line blocking and piling on proxy resources?
Alex: yes. Also KV cache promotions spiking -> more tokens produced per request which increases tail exposure.
SRE_Pager: @Alex please initiate mitigation plan and handoff to infra if config change needed.
Alex: plan: 1) enable immediate chunk-keepalive on envoy to flush with smaller chunk sizes, 2) reduce proxy downstream write timeout from 120s -> 65s for the streaming route, 3) apply circuit-breaker on per-connection pending bytes, 4) roll a canary to redirect 10% of traffic to dedicated streaming workers that bypass TTFB-heavy middleware. doing step 1 now.
Marta: +1 to canary. also start capturing tcpdump on a few stuck connections.
Josh: notifying customers slack #support-streaming with a brief note.
Linda: I'm on logs/traces — correlating client ids to slow consumers and sending a tiny eval to confirm behavior.
Kevin: applied smaller chunking policy to envoy cluster streaming-route (chunk_max_bytes=8kb, flush_interval_ms=150). watching metrics.
Alex: immediate effect: p95 -> 0.68s, p99 -> 1.12s (after 30s). still seeing a tail of long-lived sockets though.
SRE_Pager: escalate if p99 > 1.5s for next 10m.
Marta: rolling proxy downstream write timeout to 65s on a canary subset (env-front-3a).
Alex: tcpdump shows clients that are fully idle for ~40s then catch up; those are likely mobile clients on suspending networks. adding a keepalive probe to detect dead consumers sooner.
Kevin: enabling keepalive probe (tcp_keepalive_time=30s) on canary.
Josh: support update posted — customers seeing partial stalls; recommending retry with exponential backoff. link to status: https://status.redwood.example/incident/1749999999
Linda: tracing snippets for one stuck request:
```
root: request id=abcd1234
upstream latency: 1.1s
proxy write stall: 18s
client ack gap: 16s
```
Linda: correlated to mobile carrier X in us-west-2 (several clients).
Marta: looks like two drivers: 1) slow mobile consumers causing proxy buffers to fill, 2) bursty upstream token emission increasing pressure. both increase p99 tail.
Alex: mitigation checkpoint: after chunking + keepalive + timeout changes on canary, p99 dropped to 0.95s cluster-wide for canary traffic. rolling to 50% now.
SRE_Pager: notifying infra to prepare to scale dedicated streaming workers if rollout needs more headroom. @Kevin please coordinate.
Kevin: infra ready to spin up 8 more streaming nodes (gpu-pool-burst). hitting the scale API now.
Alex: started traffic shift 50% -> new streaming pool for long responses. metrics: active_sockets on standard pool down 23%.
Josh: support: updating affected customers: we see an improvement and are rolling mitigations. will follow up with post-mortem once root cause confirmed. :thumbsup:
Marta: collecting longer-term fixes: 1) per-client backpressure detection and shed; 2) smarter emitter pacing on server to avoid bursts when client acking slow; 3) proxy-level soft drop for idle downstreams.
Alex: adding an incident note with links to the applied config diffs and rollback steps. diff excerpts:
```
- envoy: cluster.streaming.downstream_idle_timeout: 120s
+ envoy: cluster.streaming.downstream_idle_timeout: 65s
- envoy: cluster.streaming.chunk_max_bytes: 32kb
+ envoy: cluster.streaming.chunk_max_bytes: 8kb
```
Kevin: final check: p95=0.52s p99=0.9s error_rate=0.12% over last 5m. marking incident as mitigated, but keeping pager active for 2h.
SRE_Pager: great work. please file a postmortem template and include action items for SDK/frontend teams to handle client-side backpressure.
Alex: will file postmortem, assigning owners for mitigations. closing thread for active paging but leaving for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
